mn68:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu viharati Naḷakapāne palāsavane.
mn68:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā kulaputtā Bhagavantaṃ uddissa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā honti,
mn68:2.2: āyasmā ca Anuruddho āyasmā ca Nandiyo āyasmā ca Kimbilo āyasmā ca Bhagu āyasmā ca Kuṇḍadhāno āyasmā ca Revato āyasmā ca Ānando, aññe ca abhiññātā abhiññātā kulaputtā.
mn68:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn68:3.2: Atha kho Bhagavā te kulaputte ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn68:3.3: Ye te bhikkhave kulaputtā mamaṃ uddissa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, kacci te bhikkhave bhikkhū abhiratā brahmacariye ti.
mn68:3.4: Evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
mn68:3.5: Dutiyam-pi kho --pe-- tatiyam-pi kho Bhagavā te kulaputte ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn68:3.6: Ye te bhikkhave kulaputtā mamaṃ uddissa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā kacci te bhikkhave bhikkhū abhiratā
mn68:3.10: Tatiyam-pi kho te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
mn68:4.3: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ āmantesi:
mn68:4.4: Kacci tumhe Anuruddhā abhiratā brahmacariye ti. --
mn68:4.5: Taggha mayaṃ bhante abhiratā brahmacariye ti. --
mn68:5.2: Etaṃ kho Anuruddhā tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ yaṃ tumhe abhirameyyātha brahmacariye.
mn68:5.3: Yena tumhe Anuruddhā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā paṭhamena vayasā susukāḷakesā kāme paribhuñjeyyātha, tena tumhe Anuruddhā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā paṭhamena vayasā susukāḷakesā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā.
mn68:5.4: Te kho pana tumhe Anuruddhā n' eva rājābhinītā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, na corābhinītā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, na iṇaṭṭā . . . na bhayaṭṭā . . . na ājīvikāpakatā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā;
mn68:5.5: api ca kho 'mhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto,
mn68:5.6: app-eva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti,
mn68:5.7: nanu tumhe Anuruddhā evaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā ti. --
mn68:6.1: Evaṃ pabbajitena ca pana Anuruddhā kulaputtena kim-assa karaṇīyaṃ:
mn68:6.2: Vivekaṃ Anuruddhā kāmehi vivekaṃ akusalehi dhammehi pītisukhaṃ nādhigacchati aññaṃ vā tato santataraṃ, tassa abhijjhā pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, byāpādo pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, thīnamiddham-pi . . . uddhaccakukkuccam-pi . . . vicikicchā pi . . . arati pi \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ . . . tandī pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
mn68:6.3: Vivekaṃ Anuruddhā kāmehi vivekaṃ akusalehi dhammehi pītisukhaṃ nādhigacchati aññaṃ vā tato santataraṃ.
mn68:6.4: Vivekaṃ Anuruddhā kāmehi vivekaṃ akusalehi dhammehi pītisukhaṃ adhigacchati aññañ-ca tato santataraṃ, tassa abhijjhā pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, byāpādo pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, thīnamiddham-pi . . . uddhaccakukkuccam-pi . . . vicikicchā pi . . . arati pi . . . tandī pi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
